title: His White Shirt
reference_source: Максимальный гламурный регистр в рамках одетого кадра
mood_ru: Утро после. Только его рубашка, смятое белое бельё, ветер в занавесках.
allure: morning-after glamour, oversized shirt open low and slipping off one shoulder, long bare legs, tousled hair, sleepy heavy-lidded gaze

wardrobe.notes_ru: Огромная мужская рубашка на голое тело — расстёгнута низко, но закрывает.
wardrobe.prompt: oversized white cotton men's shirt worn on bare skin, unbuttoned low but still covering her, sleeves rolled up, hem falling to the top of her thighs, long bare legs, silver star pendant, tousled loose hair

location.notes_ru: Спальня утром, смятое белое бельё, тюль на ветру.
location.prompt: sunlit bedroom in the morning, rumpled white linen bed, sheer white curtains lifting in the breeze, coffee cup on the nightstand, warm oak floor, dust in the light

shots.pose: standing in the open window with the sheer curtain lifting around her legs, one hand gripping the frame above her head so the shirt falls open, other hand on her hip, eyes into the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, frontal, full body vertical framing
shots.light: strong backlight through the curtain haloing her whole silhouette, warm fill off the white linen

shots.pose: kneeling on the rumpled bed with the shirt slipping off one shoulder, both hands pushing through her tousled hair, elbows wide, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, frontal, thigh-up framing
shots.light: soft morning window light wrapping from camera left, warm linen bounce under the jaw

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the rumpled white linen bed, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: standing close to the tall bedroom mirror, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: standing at the open window with the curtain lifting around her with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: reclining back on the rumpled white linen bed propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the open collar of the shirt and the pendant against her skin, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: lying on her back on the rumpled white linen bed, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: standing tall barefoot in the middle of the sunlit floor, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows

shots.pose: seen small across the space by the far window of the bedroom, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: soft morning sun filtered through the sheer curtain, warm bounce off the white linen filling the shadows
